channel.title: IT Tools Gems
channel.description: IT tools watch for a 3D studio — render farm, storage, backup, deployment, network, security — open source first.

item.title: OliveTin 3000.22.0
item.description: Covered on Oct 25: 3000.22.0 (Nov 13) fixes two HIGH flaws in the OAuth/JWKS login guarding your script buttons, adds a Docker healthcheck and deprecates StartActionByGet. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: Pulse 6.8.0
item.description: Covered on Nov 3: stable 6.8.0 (Nov 13) groups backup problems by cause, forecasts PBS datastore fill and sets a temperature limit per sensor. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: GLPI 12.0.2 (security fix)
item.description: Covered on Oct 29: 12.0.2 (Nov 12) patches five High flaws, including privilege escalation via the legacy API and account takeover through embedded dashboards or password resets. Update your inventory. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: Pi-hole 6.6
item.description: Covered on Oct 18: 6.6 (Nov 11) fixes four High flaws (symlinks followed as root, SQL injection in gravity), swaps sudo for setpriv and drops password hashes from the debug log. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: rclone 1.76.0
item.description: Covered on Oct 12: 1.76 (Nov 6) fixes a batch of flaws (planted symlinks on local, credential leaks on redirects, unauthenticated rc) and adds the index command and kDrive. Update your NAS syncs. Found via the official changelog.

item.title: Homepage 2.8.0
item.description: Covered on Oct 18: the self-hosted dashboard ships 2.8.0 on Nov 11, with fixed Synology (encoded credentials) and QNAP (volume usage) widgets, more Beszel fields and a localized sign-in page. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: Zellij 0.46.0
item.description: The open source terminal multiplexer also becomes a desktop terminal (zellij terminal) on Linux, macOS and Windows with 0.46.0 on Nov 11; sessions stay shareable with the classic mode. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: PowerShell 7.7.0
item.description: Stable 7.7.0 released on Nov 10, built on the .NET 11 SDK: it now warns about SHA-1 file catalogs and bundles PSResourceGet 1.3.0-rc2. Worth testing against your Windows fleet scripts. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: pyinfra 3.11.0
item.description: The open source tool that turns Python into shell commands on your servers (SSH, local, Docker) ships 3.11 on Nov 9: apt.hold, files.rename, supervisorctl operations, a Rich-based CLI and sturdier SSH (ProxyJump, CAs). Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: rat-commander 1.9.9
item.description: An open source successor to Midnight Commander: two local/SFTP/SCP/FTP panels plus built-in disk, process and network explorers. 1.9.9 (Oct 12) adds a portable mode to run it from a USB stick on Windows. Found via Terminal Trove (Nov 11).

item.title: Cockpit 372
item.description: Already covered Oct 25. The open source Linux admin web UI ships 372 on Nov 10 with two CVE fixes: SSH keys are now added with the user's own rights instead of sudo, and memory for fragmented messages is capped. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: Semaphore UI 2.19.22
item.description: The open source web UI for running your Ansible playbooks, Terraform or scripts ships three security fixes on Nov 9 and 10: a Manager can no longer touch another project's repositories or vaults. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: Nushell 0.117.0
item.description: The open source structured-data shell ships 0.117 on Nov 9: @structured turns an external command's output into a table, a status line flags errors before you hit Enter, and .env files load natively. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: Wazuh 4.14.10
item.description: Already covered Oct 17. The open source SIEM's stable branch moves to 4.14.10 on Nov 9 with a batch of fixes: a root command injection in rootcheck, path traversals and RBAC flaws. Worth applying to your managers. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: Open WebUI 0.13.3
item.description: The self-hosted LLM interface ships 0.13.1 to 0.13.3 on Nov 8: Claude Code or Codex show up as models, the Tether app links your machine without opening ports, and automations can run an agent. Custom license. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: Dagu 2.26.0
item.description: Self-hosted workflow orchestrator (YAML, single binary, no database), a cron alternative: 2.26.0 on Nov 7 adds a per-DAG restart_policy plus signed Windows binaries with a Scoop manifest. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: lazygit 0.66.3
item.description: The terminal Git client ships 0.66.3 on Nov 8: it ignores submodules whose name or path in .gitmodules leads outside the repo, and removing a submodule in a linked worktree no longer breaks the main one. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: InvenTree 1.7.1 (security fixes)
item.description: The inventory ERP (already covered as 1.7.0) ships 1.7.1 on Nov 8: metadata endpoints now honor model permissions, and API token issuance checks MFA. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: Zerobyte 0.44.1
item.description: Restic backup web UI (already covered as 0.44.0): 0.44.1 on Nov 7 adds CSRF protection on the session API, explicit trusted origins for passkeys, and resynchronizes task progress. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: Pulse 6.8.0-rc.1
item.description: Proxmox/NAS monitoring (already covered as 6.7.0): the 6.8.0 RC on Nov 8 groups backup health by cause, adds a per-sensor Linux temperature limit and datastore fill forecasts. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: fzf 0.75.0
item.description: The terminal fuzzy finder reaches 0.75.0 on Nov 7: you can change the --info command on the fly, MSI installers arrive on Windows, and --listen no longer stalls on a large request. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: Wiki.js 3.1.1
item.description: The open source self-hosted wiki reaches the 3.x line (3.1.1 on Nov 6): long-awaited major rewrite, 2.x import and session fixes. Handy for studio docs. Found via Self-Host Weekly (Nov 6).

item.title: wolf 2026.11
item.description: Moonlight/Sunshine host to stream desktops and GPUs from Docker: first monthly release (2026.11) after 2 years, Fedora base image with updated Mesa drivers. Ideal for remote 3D workstations. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: Zabbix 8.0.0
item.description: Enterprise open source monitoring: 8.0.0 on Nov 5 adds OpenTelemetry (traces, proxy collector), a ClickHouse backend, a modernized UI and Proxmox/GLPI templates. Found via the official Zabbix release notes.

item.title: Coolify 4.6.0
item.description: Self-hosted deployment platform (already covered as 4.5.0): 4.6.0 on Nov 2 requires the “delete” ability (or root) for every API/MCP deletion and hardens GitHub CI. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: ntfy 2.37.2
item.description: Self-hosted push notifications (already covered as 2.31.1): 2.37.0 on Nov 2 shares the UnifiedPush subscriber across servers and adds Retry-After / RateLimit; 2.37.2 on Nov 4. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: ownCloud Infinite Scale 8.2.3
item.description: Self-hosted file storage: 8.2.3 on Nov 6 bumps vulnerable dependencies (golang.org/x/net…) and fixes a data race on the web theme. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: s3-orchestrator
item.description: Open source S3 layer (MIT): one endpoint in front of many backends (B2, R2, MinIO, Wasabi…), N copies, quotas, zstd and envelope encryption. Added to awesome-selfhosted on Nov 2. Found via awesome-selfhosted-data.

item.title: OpenSSH 10.6p2
item.description: Critical fix on Nov 5 (“sshole”): on musl without PAM (Alpine), a ≥257-byte password could unlock a “*” account. Update and restart sshd. Found via the Alpine security advisory.

item.title: Incus 7.6.0
item.description: The container/VM manager ships 7.6 on Oct 30: 18 security fixes (several critical — project isolation, paths, certificates) and performance for large clusters. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: InvenTree 1.7.0
item.description: Parts/stock inventory ERP reaches 1.7.0 on Nov 3: security fixes (exports, reports, sessions/tokens), edit history and a pricing role. Handy for studio hardware. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: Vector 0.61.0
item.description: The open source observability pipeline ships 0.61 on Oct 29: OpenSearch sink, Databricks TLS fix (certificate/hostname verification), one breaking change — read the upgrade guide. Found via the Vector release notes.

item.title: bootvine 0.1.3
item.description: Live systemd job tree at boot/shutdown (LUKS, failures + journal lines): 0.1.3 on Nov 5 fixes false failures. Handy to diagnose slow-booting workstations. Found via Terminal Trove.

item.title: Pangolin 1.26.0
item.description: The remote-access reverse proxy ships 1.26 on Nov 3: optional CrowdSec bot detection, base wildcard match; Enterprise adds revocable sessions, SSH logs and continuous OIDC revalidation. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: siltide 0.1.5
item.description: TUI fleet monitor for GPUs/NPUs (15 vendors): utilization, VRAM, thermals, processes and Kubernetes/Slurm pods, plus an API and Prometheus metrics. One binary, open source (Apache-2.0). Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: rmlint 2.11.0
item.description: The ultra-fast duplicate finder ships 2.11.0 on Nov 1 (“Evolving Echidna”): GUI/replay fixes, better macOS/FreeBSD. Handy to reclaim space on a studio NAS. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: Dozzle 11.4.1
item.description: The real-time Docker log viewer reaches 11.4.1 on Nov 5: alerts when a newer image is available, a role to restrict updates, and safer host cleanup (keep=true). Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: Headscale 0.29.7
item.description: The open source Tailscale control server ships security 0.29.7 on Oct 30 (Anthropic scan + Tailworm report): DoS fixes, pair with Tailscale ≥1.104.4 on nodes. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: Atuin 18.24.5
item.description: Synced shell history ships 18.24.5 on Nov 4: dependency security fix (RUSTSEC-2026-0433), fuller preloaded search, more robust MCP and scripts. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: mise 2026.11.0
item.description: The tool and task manager ships 2026.11.0 on Nov 3: a task can declare a lock to wait its turn on a single shared resource (test database, GPU), even across terminals. Stricter lockfiles, read the breaking changes. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: Caddy 2.11.8
item.description: The automatic-HTTPS web server and reverse proxy ships 2.11.8 on Nov 4, a batch of fixes and security hardening, recommended if you serve PHP or use {host} in file paths. A few config breaking changes to read first. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: PatchMon 2.1.7
item.description: The fleet patch tracker ships 2.1.7 on Nov 3: RDP survives a host reboot, Windows updates with spaces in their names deploy, re-enrolment no longer duplicates hosts, and Go 1.26.10 brings a TLS fix. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: DashBeam
item.description: Free (AGPL) end-to-end encrypted peer-to-peer file transfer, no cloud or account: folders of any size checked with BLAKE3, resumable transfers, LAN discovery, CLI and browser. Added to awesome-selfhosted on Nov 2. Found via awesome-selfhosted-data.

item.title: FOG Project 1.6.0
item.description: After 21 RCs, the open source PXE imaging and workstation deployment tool ships stable 1.6.0 on Nov 2: built-in roles and multi-site, LDAP/OIDC sign-in, API Bearer tokens, audit trail. One-way upgrade, back up first. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: Pulse 6.7.0
item.description: The Proxmox monitoring dashboard reaches stable 6.7.0 on Nov 2: clearer Proxmox backups (restore points counted apart from failures), TrueNAS CORE metrics restored and config recovery that rejects incomplete backups. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: ansible-core 2.22.0
item.description: The fleet automation engine ships 2.22.0 on Nov 2: secrets (Vault passwords, no_log values) are now automatically masked in all output and logs. Python 3.15 supported, 3.12 dropped on the controller. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: Vaultwarden 1.37.5
item.description: The lightweight self-hosted Bitwarden server ships 1.37.5 on Nov 1 with two security fixes (website icons, emergency access), the bundled 2026.10.1 web vault and config validated at startup. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: nvidia_gpu_exporter 1.17.0
item.description: Already seen at 1.16.0, the Prometheus exporter for NVIDIA GPUs ships 1.17.0 on Nov 2: native NVML backend on Windows, per-process metrics, NVLink, a health endpoint and encoder/decoder panels. Handy for a mixed render farm. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: chezmoi 2.74.0
item.description: The open source dotfiles manager that syncs your shell and tool config across all your machines ships 2.74.0 on Nov 1: KeePassXC/YubiKey, gopass and 1Password Connect integrations plus the ssh and docker commands are now stable. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: Scrutiny 0.10.0
item.description: The open source SMART dashboard for your NAS and server drives ships 0.10.0 on Nov 1: alerts when a machine stops sending readings, editable drive names, and total bytes read/written per drive. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: bottom 0.15.0
item.description: The open source terminal system monitor (btm) reaches 0.15.0 on Nov 1: first per-process Intel GPU tracking on Linux, a swap column, and it no longer wakes idle NVIDIA GPUs to read their stats. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: Wazuh 5.0.0 RC2
item.description: Already seen Oct 17 as 4.14.9: the open source security platform (SIEM/XDR) ships its 5.0 RC2 on Oct 30, with agents over HTTPS, a new analysis engine, cluster-by-default and CVSS v4. Test it outside production. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: Kanidm 1.12.0
item.description: The open source identity server (LDAP, OAuth2, Unix accounts for Linux workstations) ships 1.12.0 on Nov 1: self-service account signup, a medium-severity LDAP fix and a reworked admin UI. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: Stalwart 1.0
item.description: The open source mail and collaboration server (AGPL, IMAP, JMAP, SMTP, CalDAV) hits 1.0 stable on Oct 26 with a frozen database schema, then 1.0.1 on Oct 28 with Prometheus and OpenTelemetry exporters. Found via Self-Host Weekly, Oct 30.

item.title: Tailscale 1.104.4 (correctif SSH)
item.description: Freemium, open source client: the mesh VPN ships 1.104.4 on Oct 28, fixing the Tailscale SSH flaws disclosed in the "Tailworm" report. Roll it out quickly if you use it for workstation access. Found via Self-Host Weekly, Oct 30.

item.title: Zerobyte 0.44.0
item.description: Open source (AGPL) web UI to automate your restic backups: 0.44.0, out Oct 31, hides encrypted credentials in API responses, enables mirroring between SFTP repositories and bundles rclone 1.75.2. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: Duplicati 2.4.1.0
item.description: Already featured at 2.4.0.1, the encrypted backup tool ships an Oct 29 stable release adding automatic restore tests after backups and incremental Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace backups. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: Icinga 2 2.16.6
item.description: The open source monitoring engine ships an Oct 28 security fix worth applying: command injection through the default mail notification scripts, a daemon crash and API information leaks fixed. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: NetBird 0.82.0
item.description: Already featured at 0.81.0, the self-hostable WireGuard mesh VPN ships on Oct 29 latency-aware HA routing that no longer drops SSH sessions, plus a readable `netbird status --table` for large networks. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: GLPI 12.0.1 (security fix)
item.description: Already featured at 12.0.0, the asset manager and helpdesk ships an Oct 28 security fix worth applying: a critical external authentication bypass, a privilege escalation and several XSS flaws fixed. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: OpenCloud 9.0.0
item.description: This self-hosted file sharing platform ships 9.0 on Oct 27: email guest access with no account or password, single-use links and every access logged, plus tag search and HEIC/AVIF previews. Upgrade steps required. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: Woodpecker CI 3.20.0
item.description: This lightweight self-hosted CI engine ships 3.20 on Oct 28 with a batch of hardening: agent token removed from the environment, bearer secrets no longer logged. Heads-up: backslashes in pipelines are no longer unescaped. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: FOG Project 1.6.0 RC-18
item.description: PXE disk image deployment ships RC-18 on Oct 27: a new Performance Test task times disk, network and decompression on the client without touching the disk, and FOS now checks the server’s TLS certificate. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: CrowdSec 1.8.2
item.description: The collaborative security engine (MIT) ships 1.8.2 on Oct 26: rate limiting in its WAF, JavaScript bot detection rules distributed through the hub, a new cscli bot command and a faster engine. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: GitButler 0.23.0
item.description: Free, FSL licensed (MIT after 2 years): the parallel-branch Git client ships 0.23.0 on Oct 27. It works in any repo with no setup, handles Git worktrees (GUI and the but CLI) and speeds up Git LFS repos. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: Uptime Kuma 2.5.8
item.description: A security update to apply: 2.5.8 (Oct 26) of the self-hosted uptime monitor fixes an admin-only remote code execution flaw and turns the never-reliable TLS TCP monitors into plain TCP monitors. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: Tactical RMM 1.6.1
item.description: The self-hosted RMM (source-available license) ships 1.6.0 then 1.6.1 (Oct 26-27): a native file browser with resumable transfers and no MeshCentral, a signed macOS agent, Debian 13 and Ubuntu 26.04 support. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: nvidia_gpu_exporter 1.16.0
item.description: The Prometheus exporter for NVIDIA GPUs ships 1.16.0 (Oct 25): the NVML backend graduates out of experimental and reports clock throttling reasons (board limit, reliability). Handy for watching render farm GPUs. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: OpenBao 2.7.2
item.description: The open source secrets vault (a Vault fork) ships 2.7.2 (Oct 26) with five security fixes, including a path traversal in transit and wildcards now denied by default in SSH certificates. Worth applying soon. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: Dozzle 11.3.5
item.description: The web-based Docker log viewer ships 11.3.5 (Oct 24): scheduled image and volume cleanup with a preview before deletion, container update alerts, uptime and disk I/O columns, and a Helm chart. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: Harbor 2.14.6
item.description: The CNCF's self-hosted container registry ships 2.14.6 (Oct 23): Go dependencies upgraded to fix high and critical CVEs, Go 1.26.10, an updated Trivy, and a byte limit against decompression bombs. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: Codex CLI 0.164.0
item.description: OpenAI's open source coding agent for the terminal (OpenAI account required) ships 0.164.0 (Oct 23): /presets for reusable prompts, inline /model and /permissions, and credential masking in remote Bash commands. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: Pele 1.10.0
item.description: Obsidian's MIT-licensed, dependency-free engine that renders Mermaid diagrams to SVG, handy to document your network or farm, ships 1.10.0 (Oct 24) with more precise errors. Found via your X bookmarks (post by @obsdmd).

item.title: wg-easy 15.5.0
item.description: The web UI to run and manage a WireGuard server in Docker ships 15.5.0 (Oct 24): Node.js security fixes, AmneziaWG 3.1, a configurable interface name, trusted proxies, and peer endpoints in Prometheus metrics. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: Pangolin 1.25.3
item.description: The tunneled reverse proxy, a self-hosted alternative to a VPN for exposing your services, follows the 1.25 series (HTTP redirects, mTLS, machine roles) with 1.25.3 (Oct 23): Node updated for a vulnerability, faster client connections. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: OliveTin 3000.21.0
item.description: OliveTin puts your shell scripts behind web buttons, handy to let the team restart a service without SSH. 3000.21.0 (Oct 24) adds -syntaxcheck to validate the config and -startuptrace, and surfaces config errors in the UI. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: ZITADEL 4.20.0
item.description: The open source identity provider (SSO, OIDC, SAML) reaches 4.20.0 (Oct 22): a Go 1.26 build that rejects certificates chaining through the compromised eMudhra intermediates, so check your SMTP and external IdPs before upgrading. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: Cockpit 370
item.description: The web admin console for Linux servers ships release 370 (Oct 22): storage management now recognizes TPM2 key slots on encrypted volumes and supports UTF-8 mount points. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: JuiceFS 1.4.2
item.description: The distributed POSIX file system built on S3 storage ships 1.4.2 (Oct 22): no more bad reads after object storage timeouts, SQL garbage collection deleting live data, or losses from stale transaction retries. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: PatchMon 2.1.6
item.description: Open source (AGPL) platform to track and deploy security updates across a Linux fleet from a web UI: agents, validation, scheduled patches, history. 2.1.6 (Oct 17) fixes installs behind Traefik + CrowdSec. Found via Self-Host Weekly, Oct 23.

item.title: Coolify 4.5.0
item.description: The self-hosted PaaS reaches 4.5.0 (Oct 23): server patching (beta) with automatic security updates, a fleet metrics page, a file browser, passkey sign-in, and an automatic database backup before updates. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: Homebox 0.27.1
item.description: The self-hosted inventory tool (hardware, cables, spare parts) ships 0.27.1 (Oct 23), a security release patching the Node.js "Node2Shell" flaw; the team advises updating as soon as possible. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: SeaweedFS 4.49
item.description: The distributed S3-compatible object/file store ships 4.49 (Oct 23): remote cache eviction under disk pressure, vacuum that reclaims full read-only volumes, and IAM roles managed through the API. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: MeshCentral 1.3.0
item.description: The open source remote management and control tool for workstations hits 1.3.0 (Oct 21): default agent binaries now come from pinned GitHub releases, and the server no longer hangs when GitHub is unreachable. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: Trivy 0.76.1
item.description: The vulnerability scanner (images, repos, IaC) ships 0.76.1 (Oct 21) after the eMudhra intermediate CA compromise: binaries built with Go 1.27.3 and images with an updated CA store. Upgrade and redeploy. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: Atuin 18.24.2
item.description: The synced, encrypted shell history ships 18.24.2 (Oct 22): daemon, pty-proxy and config path fixes. If you self-host the server, use Docker image 18.24.2-1 (eMudhra certificates). Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: OpenCue 1.37.0
item.description: Featured before at 1.34: the render farm manager ships 1.37.0 (Oct 21), focused on Maestro at scale, a snappier CueGUI, configurable retries and OpenCueWeb/REST Docker images. DB migrations: back up first. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: Prometheus 3.15.1
item.description: Security update for the metrics engine (Oct 21): images now distrust the compromised eMudhra CAs, built with Go 1.27.3, plus HTTP/2 fixes. Worth rolling out on your monitoring stack. Found via the prometheus/prometheus GitHub release.

item.title: Arcane 2.17.0
item.description: This open source web UI for managing Docker adds native Podman support, hostname configuration and a delay before auto-updating newly available images (Oct 21). Found via the getarcaneapp/arcane GitHub release.

item.title: Pocket ID 2.19
item.description: The passkey-based OIDC provider ships 2.19 (Oct 21): forced email verification, login notifications, plus security fixes (LDAP DN collision, email enumeration). Found via the pocket-id/pocket-id v2.19.0 GitHub release.

item.title: OpenTofu 1.13.2
item.description: The open source Terraform fork ships 1.13.2 (Oct 21): filters compromised intermediate certificates, fixes possible CPU exhaustion in tofu init against a malicious HTTP/2 server, and destroy crashes. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: Snipe-IT 8.8.1
item.description: The asset and license manager ships 8.8.1 (Oct 20): built-in label editor, bulk actions and archiving, much richer Intune sync (28 fields). Requires PHP 8.2+. Found via the snipe/snipe-it GitHub release.

item.title: Docker Engine 29.9.2
item.description: Docker 29.9.2 (Oct 20) moves to Go 1.26.10, which rejects 8 compromised eMudhra intermediate certificates: a registry relying on them will make pulls and pushes fail. Check your private registry. Found via the moby/moby GitHub release.

item.title: Syncthing 2.1.7
item.description: Seen as an RC on Oct 16, Syncthing 2.1.7 is now stable (Oct 21): SQLite fixes, bad network data handled as errors instead of panics, and receive-only folder reconciliation fixed. Found via the syncthing/syncthing GitHub release.

item.title: Healthchecks 5.0
item.description: The cron and scheduled-job monitor (backups, render scripts) hits 5.0 (Oct 20): the Docker image swaps uWSGI for gunicorn (GUNICORN_WORKERS) and restarts the whole container if a process crashes. Check your compose. Found via the healthchecks/healthchecks GitHub release.

item.title: Warpgate 0.30.0
item.description: Seen on Oct 13 as a beta, the SSH/RDP/HTTP bastion goes stable (Oct 19): Vault/OpenBao secrets, on-the-fly signed SSH certs, OIDC back-channel logout and 4 vulns fixed (TOTP MFA, admin CSRF). Found via the warp-tech/warpgate GitHub release.

item.title: LibreNMS 26.10.1
item.description: Open source SNMP network monitoring: 26.10.0 (Oct 19) fixes about fifteen vulns (XSS, API permissions), drops collectd and adds Nutanix storage and PDU outlets; 26.10.1 (Oct 20) reverts an issue with old fping. Found via the librenms/librenms GitHub releases.

item.title: uv 0.13.2
item.description: Astral’s ultra-fast Python manager ships 0.13.2 (Oct 19): a much leaner resolver on big dependency graphs, retried network requests, and URL credentials no longer leaking into logs. Found via the astral-sh/uv GitHub release.

item.title: Gitea 28.2.0
item.description: Your self-hosted Git forge ships 28.2.0 (Oct 18): about thirty fixes, including LFS OID validation, checked OpenID state, a patched golang.org/x/net and sturdier Actions. Found via the go-gitea/gitea GitHub release.

item.title: mise 2026.10.14
item.description: The CLI tool and task manager adds (Oct 18) a global config.override.toml that beats project config, mise config explain, and per-category paranoid mode. Heads-up: an unknown tool option now fails the install. Found via the jdx/mise GitHub release.
